title: 第十二章 报名受阻第十一章 众人设局灌酒
slug: 震惊五星灵帝被逼着撩妹
lines: 三个月的时间，一晃而过。
杨卤在这三个月里，每天早上雷打不动地去冰澜阁送早餐，风雨无阻。瑶青池从一开始的怒拒、冷脸、无视，到后来逐渐麻木，甚至偶尔会打开门，看他一眼，然后默默接过食盒。
当然，大部分时候她还是不开门，直接把食盒放在门口就走。
杨卤无所谓，反正系统认的是“送”这个动作，不是“吃”这个结果。
三个月下来，他的许愿值已经涨到了三万出头。虽然距离一百万还差得远，但至少是在稳步前进。
而今天，是宗门季度内门弟子比武报名的日子。
杨卤一大早就来到了宗门广场。此刻广场上已经聚集了上百名内门弟子，一个个摩拳擦掌，跃跃欲试。比武场地的中央搭起了一座高台，台上摆放着一排座椅，几名长老已经落座。
主持这场报名的，是内务长老海富。
海富是个看起来五十出头的中年修士，身材微胖，面相和善，二星灵王大圆满的修为，在宗门里主要负责内务管理和赛事组织。他站在高台上，手里拿着一本名册，笑呵呵地看着台下众弟子。
“诸位师弟，今日是宗门季度内门弟子比武的报名日。规矩大家都知道，我就不多说了。”海富清了清嗓子，“有意参加比武的，请到台前来登记姓名、修为、所属长老。初赛名单将会在明日公布，赛程持续七天，最终决出前三名，给予丰厚奖励！”
台下顿时一片欢呼。
杨卤从人群中走出来，径直走到台前，拱手道：“长老，我要报名。”
他的出现，让原本热闹的广场瞬间安静了下来。
所有人的目光都集中到了他身上。
杨卤。
这个名字在星澜宗已经无人不知、无人不晓了。
神谕灵天赋，强闯山门，打伤守门弟子，每天都给圣女送早餐，还扇过圣女一巴掌，一个人灌翻了七个内门弟子……
这三个月，他的事迹在宗门里传得神乎其神，但有一点是所有人的共识——他是个挂逼，他有那枚戒指。
海富看着他，脸上的笑容微微一僵。
“杨卤啊……”海富合上名册，语气有些为难，“你要参加比武？”
“对。”杨卤点了点头。
海富沉默了几秒，然后压低声音说道：“杨师弟，不瞒你说，你的实力大家有目共睹。但问题是……你的那枚戒指，也太强了。你要是戴着它参赛，其他弟子根本没法跟你打。”
杨卤眉头一皱：“那我不戴戒指不就行了？”
“你不戴戒指？”海富愣了一下，“你确定？”
“确定。”杨卤点了点头，然后伸出左手，当着所有人的面，把那枚漆黑戒指摘了下来，塞进怀里。
广场上瞬间炸开了锅。
“他摘戒指了？”
“真的假的？他要裸装上阵？”
“没了那戒指，他不就是个普通二星灵王入灵境吗？有什么好怕的？”
“就是！之前都是靠戒指的力量在装逼！”
“没了戒指，我看他怎么赢！”
杨卤听着周围的议论声，面无表情。
他当然不怕。
因为那枚戒指本来就不是增幅战力的，而是压制他气息的。
content_en:
Three months passed by in a flash.
In the past three months, Yang Lu went to Binglan Pavilion to deliver breakfast every morning, rain or shine. Yao Qingchi went from an angry refusal, a cold face, and a disregard at the beginning to gradually becoming numb. She would even occasionally open the door, look at him, and then silently accept the food box.
Of course, most of the time she still doesn't open the door, just puts the food box at the door and leaves.
Yang Lu didn't care. Anyway, the system recognized the action of "sending", not the result of "eating".
After three months, his wish value has risen to over 30,000. Although it is still far from one million, it is at least making steady progress.
Today is the day for the sect’s quarterly internal disciples to register for the competition.
Yang Lu arrived at Zongmen Square early in the morning. At this moment, hundreds of inner disciples have gathered in the square, all gearing up and eager to try. A high platform was erected in the center of the competition venue. There was a row of seats on the platform, and several elders were already seated.
The person who presided over the registration was Hai Fu, the elder of the internal affairs department.
Haifu is a middle-aged monk who looks to be in his early fifties. He is slightly fat, has a kind face, and has the perfect cultivation level of a two-star spiritual king. He is mainly responsible for housekeeping and event organization in the sect. He stood on the high platform, holding a roster in his hand, and looked at the disciples in the audience with a smile.
"Junior brothers, today is the registration day for the sect's quarterly internal disciple competition. Everyone knows the rules, so I won't go into details." Hai Fu cleared his throat, "Those who are interested in participating in the competition, please come to the stage to register your name, cultivation level, and elder. The preliminary list will be announced tomorrow. The competition will last for seven days. The top three will be determined and generous rewards will be given!"
The audience burst into cheers.
Yang Lu walked out of the crowd, walked straight to the stage, cupped his hands and said, "Elder, I want to sign up."
His appearance instantly silenced the originally lively square.
All eyes were focused on him.
Yang Lu.
This name is already known to everyone in Xinglan Sect.
With the gift of the oracle spirit, he forced his way into the mountain gate, injured the gatekeeper, brought breakfast to the saint every day, even slapped the saint, and overpowered seven inner disciples by himself...
In the past three months, his deeds have been legendary in the sect, but there is one thing that everyone agrees on - he is a cheat, and he has that ring.
Haifu looked at him, the smile on his face froze slightly.
"Yang Lu..." Haifu closed the roster with a somewhat embarrassed tone, "You want to participate in the competition?"
"Yes." Yang Lu nodded.
Haifu was silent for a few seconds, then lowered his voice and said, "Junior brother Yang, to tell you the truth, your strength is obvious to all. But the problem is... that ring of yours is too strong. If you wear it in the competition, other disciples will not be able to fight with you."
Yang Lu frowned: "Then it's okay if I don't wear a ring?"
"You don't wear a ring?" Haifu was stunned for a moment, "Are you sure?"
"OK." Yang Lu nodded, then stretched out his left hand, took off the dark ring in front of everyone, and stuffed it into his arms.
The square exploded instantly.
"Did he take off his ring?"
"Really or not? He wants to go into battle naked?"
"Without that ring, wouldn't he be just an ordinary two-star spiritual king entering the spiritual realm? What is there to be afraid of?"
"That's right! I used to rely on the power of the ring to show off!"
"Without the ring, I don't see how he can win!"
Yang Lu listened to the discussions around him with an expressionless face.
Of course he's not afraid.
Because the ring was not meant to increase combat power, but to suppress his aura.
title_en: Chapter 12: Registration is blocked Chapter 11: Everyone sets up a trap to get drunk
